clips.title: The story
paras: Barnil Stonepot was trusted to proofread the manuscript for Hemet Nesingwary's novel, but a fierce gust of wind scattered the loose pages across the jungle. To spare him his master's anger, you are asked to scour the wilds, assemble the missing pages into four complete chapters, and return the finished work.

Following your arrival in the expedition camp after Welcome to the Jungle, Barnil Stonepot finds himself facing a disaster. While reviewing the draft of Hemet Nesingwary's novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn, a sudden gale caught the loose leaves and flung them into the wild. Though he managed to recover a fair portion of the work, many sheets remain lost in the brush. To keep his master from discovering the mishap, he needs every misplaced page tracked down and compiled into Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III, and Chapter IV.

Bringing back the four completed sections spares Barnil from an unpleasant confrontation with Nesingwary. With the chapters gathered safely in hand, he hopes the restored work will soon find its way into libraries across the world.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Master Nesingwary will be so upset if he finds out!
He trusted me to proofread the manuscript of his novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Everything was going well, but a large gust of wind blew through the camp and scattered the pages everywhere!
I was able to gather most of the pages but many are still strewn about the jungle. Collect the pages to complete each of the four chapters.
I will help you organize them. Return the chapters to me once you have all four.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you assembled the chapters yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've certainly saved me a heap of trouble, friend! I can't thank you enough. It shouldn't be long now until we see Master Nesingwary's book in libraries throughout the world!
